requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Whether the agency took fingerprints at that arrest, as far as you know
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Whether the agency took fingerprints at that arrest, as far as you know
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the statute's ground exists only where no fingerprints were taken; only the participant can say what they know
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your answer, as far as you know, on whether fingerprints were taken at the arrest - if they were, this route is not yours, so stop

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own sworn statement of why this arrest was wrongly attributed to the movant
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own sworn statement of why this arrest was wrongly attributed to the movant
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the sworn attestation is the movant's own oath; the platform writes none of it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand sworn account of why the arrest was wrongly attributed to you - the packet asserts nothing about who committed any offence, so these lines are yours alone

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Whether the person arrested presented any other reliable identification, as far as you know
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Whether the person arrested presented any other reliable identification, as far as you know
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the statute's ground exists only where no other reliable identification was presented; only the participant can say what they know
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your answer, as far as you know, on whether the person arrested presented other reliable identification - if they did, this route is not yours, so stop

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number, copied exactly from the court record - the disposition you request in step two of the filing instructions states it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no held source states the prosecutor-routing rule or a service address, so the participant obtains both from the named checkable authority
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the office that prosecuted your case - the United States Attorney's Office for the District of Columbia or the Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia; the Criminal Division clerk's office (202-879-1373) or the Seal Team (criminalmotionsealteam@dcsc.gov) can tell you which, and the address
